newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea sells dollars at 857 to support won.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea sells dollars at 857 to support won.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea was seen selling dollars at 857.00 won in late Thursday morning to support the domestic currency, dealers said.
The central bank has refused to confirm or deny that it intervenes in the interbank market.
The won rose to 856.00 won after the intervention. It had opened at 858.
The central bank earlier sold a total of $40 million in three-month and six-month forward trading, dealers said.
